findings.title: Preserve captions containing explicit line breaks
findings.body: At ordinary Dynamic Type sizes, a caption such as "Good session\nSecond attempt" reaches this modifier through `Text(caption)` (lines 75–81). The composer accepts multiline captions through `BoardedTextEditor` and preserves internal newlines when saving. The first candidate already applies `.lineLimit(1)`, so its ideal width fits for short paragraphs even though the complete caption requires multiple lines; the horizontal-only fit check therefore selects the truncated candidate instead of the natural-height fallback. Previously, the caption used only a minimum height and retained those lines. Determine whether the unrestricted content genuinely fits one line before selecting the measured-height branch, preserving the fallback for explicit line breaks as well as width overflow.
